2092. Converting a Decimal Number to Octal

65

Problem Statement
Read a decimal number between 0 and 511 and print its 3-digit octal equivalent, using % and / to extract each octal digit.

Description
Read an integer num between 0 and 511. Extract its octal digits one at a time using the % operator with 8 (which gives the current least significant octal digit) and the / operator with 8 (which removes that digit), repeating this three times since the result always fits in 3 octal digits. Print the three digits together, most significant digit first, with no spaces between them.
input_spec: A single line containing an integer num (0 <= num <= 511).
output_spec: Print the 3-digit octal equivalent of num, as three digits with no spaces.
